newsitem.title: USA: Public Svc New Mexico bond redemption ok'd.
newsitem.headline: Public Svc New Mexico bond redemption ok'd.

text.p: Public Service Co of New Mexico said on Tuesday that it has been authorized by state regulators to redeem up to $300 million in long-term debt.

The order issued by the New Mexico Public Utility Commission allows the utility to proceed with the redemption of portions of two series of Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station lease obligation bonds. The company expects to announce terms of the transaction later this week.
Moody's Investors Service earlier this month placed the utility's credit rating under review for possible upgrade based on the planned repurchase of the bonds.

In other actions affecting the company, the commission approved its request to establish a qualified trust to fund PNM's share of projected decommissioning costs for Palo Verde units 1 and 2. The qualified trust will supplement PNM's existing trust for funding the decommissioning.
At its meeting on Tuesday, the PUC also granted Public Service Co's request for a rehearing on the company's proposal to offer a number of optional services to electric customers.
No final order has been issued on its gas rate case. The company agreed to postpone implementing its requested rates until October 30, when a final decision is expected.
